Priya (CS): heads up — several onboarding customers are reporting slow embeddings and intermittent 5xxs since ~03:12 UTC. seeing failures on batch job runs. affected: AcmeHealth, NovaDocs, KestrelAI, two smaller pilots. I'm compiling a list now.
Arjun (eng-runtime): saw spike in tail latency on embeddings workers around 03:11-03:15 UTC. kernel rollout to optimized kv-evict landed 03:10 — investigating correlation. logs show repeated `GPU OOM` during cache eviction attempts.
Jon (eng-sre): created INC-2026-042 and attached initial metrics. auto-scale triggered but some requests still hit degraded nodes. mitigation: rollback kernel patch to v1.9 at 03:45 UTC and moved affected pods to warm pool. request routing fallback to quantized-model-variant enabled.
Priya (CS): thanks. can we get a short customer-facing status we can send asap? we need to notify onboarding owners and any customers in trial.
Arjun (eng-runtime): short status: "We detected degraded embedding performance due to a recent kernel change that caused cache eviction to spike and exhaust GPU memory on some workers. We rolled back the change at 03:45 UTC and routed traffic to healthy pools; requests are returning to normal but some backfill jobs are still pending." (feel free to edit)
Elaine (CS Manager): good. include impacted window (03:10–03:50 UTC) and that we're offering a platform credit and priority reruns for onboarding batches. draft: "We're very sorry — our team identified an issue affecting embedding generation during 03:10–03:50 UTC. We rolled back the change and are rerunning impacted onboarding batches; we'll reach out when reruns complete. As a gesture, we're offering a 10% invoice credit for the impacted period and a $5k platform credit for high-touch pilots. Expect a full RCA in 48 hours."
Maya (Finance): 10% + $5k ok for pilots, approve for up to 15 named accounts. escalate to me if there are requests beyond that.
Priya (CS): I will send to onboarding owners and the four impacted pilots. quick ask: Arjun, can you provide an ETA for when reruns will finish? customers want timelines.
Arjun (eng-runtime): estimating bulk reruns by 09:30 UTC; incremental backfill continues until 12:00 UTC. will post updates to the incident and share backlog of affected job IDs. sample log: `ERROR kv_cache_eviction: GPU0 OOM at 2026-03-21T03:14:27Z, pid=2487`
Jon (eng-sre): also flagging potential follow-ups: add pre-merge safety check on kernel evict path, add canary window for future kernel swaps, and increase warm-pool threshold for embeddings during onboarding backfills.
Priya (CS): draft comm ready — dropping here for review before sending to customers. 
Priya (CS): "Hi — we wanted to let you know about a service issue that impacted embedding generation during onboarding earlier today (03:10–03:50 UTC). We rolled back the change responsible and are rerunning affected batches; expected rerun completion by 09:30 UTC. We're offering a 10% invoice credit for the impacted window and a $5k platform credit for pilot customers. A full RCA will be shared within 48 hours. If you need priority attention, reply and we'll escalate. — Priya, CS"
Elaine (CS Manager): wording looks good. add contact line for urgent issues: `cs+priority@redwood.com`. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: incident INC-2026-042 updated by Jon (eng-sre). status -> mitigation in progress. link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-042
Priya (CS): sending now to owners and affected accounts. tagging here for visibility. action items: Maya approve credits (done), Arjun provide final rerun confirmation, Jon publish incident timeline and postmortem link when ready.
Arjun (eng-runtime): will update with job IDs and a short RCA outline by EOD.
Jon (eng-sre): I'll schedule the postmortem and include remediation tickets. ETA for full RCA doc: 48 hours.
Elaine (CS Manager): thanks team. I'll follow up with any escalations and track renewal risk flags for impacted pilots.
Priya (CS): closing thread for now—will paste customer replies into this thread as they come in. :wave:
